newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai rice closes down in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai rice closes down in slow trading.

text.p: Shanghai rice futures ended down in slow trading on Wednesday on weak market sentiment, traders said.
The key September 1996 contract ended at 2,510 yuan ($302) per tonne, losing 17 yuan. It opened at an intra-day high of 2,529 yuan and hit a low of 2,490.
Combined volume fell to 5,750 tonnes from 11,250.
Traders said that panic selling drove rice below the key support 2,500-yuan level, but institutional buying later pushed it back up above 2,500.
"Weak market sentiment and poor technical charts triggered panic selling, but institutions will not let it fall below 2,500 yuan easily," one trader said.
Traders expected the September contract to continue to test the key 2,500-yuan support level in the next few days.
